patches.name: Allow screenshots
patches.description: Removes the FLAG_SECURE restriction that makes screenshots and screen recordings of the app come out black. The in-app WebView (WavesActivity) stops applying it, and the bundled no_screenshot plugin's own FLAG_SECURE hook is neutered so no screen can re-apply it.

compatiblePackages.name: RailOne
compatiblePackages.description: Indian Railways passenger app by CRIS. These patches disarm the app's anti-tamper checks so it keeps working on a re-signed build with USB debugging on.

patches.name: Bypass USB-debugging detection
patches.description: Forces the adb_enabled, adb_wifi_enabled and development_settings_enabled checks to return false, so the app runs normally while USB debugging / developer options are on.

patches.name: Disable native security SDK
patches.description: Stops AikyamApplication.onCreate() from loading libnative-lib.so, disarming the native anti-tamper SDK that force-stops the app and wipes its data. Root cause fix: the other patches only matter once this one is applied.
